label: The T schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box entails a KT route frame
meaning: If the T schema of the route's box is valid on the route's modal frame, the frame is reflexive (KT). Applies the verified premise-free StandardCorrespondenceCertificate (MODAL-STANDARD-CORRESPONDENCE-CERTIFICATE) to the route frame. Establishes neither premise; with the forward result it shows that the T schema premise and the KT frame premise are equivalent.
